answer: Each epoch the harbor auctions 30 berths: one sealed bid, 50-credit bond each; top bids win. Bids come in velvet envelopes, opened in public, so none copies a rival price. Auditors wander, tracing funding; shared-wallet bids are void, bonds burn. First fee is 36 credits, each next bid adds 8: 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000 in fees plus 50,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. A rented-bid ring loses all; an honest agent pays 36 once and keeps its bond.
